_comment: Web 版新增的文案。Godot 源项目里没有这些 key——它们的成功/失败面板是 _draw() 画出来的，文案直接写在代码里，源项目从来没把它们收进文案表。移植到 DOM/Canvas UI 之后，面板上的字必须走 i18n，所以在这里补齐。合并发生在 tools/extract-data.mjs。**除下面列出的覆盖项外只增不改**：原有 key 一个都不动，两侧集合严格一致这条断言才守得住。
_override:
少数 key 在这里是**覆盖**源项目的值。合并是 `{...源, ...本表}`，写在后面就赢，而覆盖项**只写英文侧**（中文侧继续用源表原文，所以本表天然允许不对称——`prologue_speaker` / `player_speaker` / `language` 三个既有项也是这样）。现���四组：
(1) quality_hint_low / _medium / _high —— 源文案 quality_hint 还在讲草皮几何体，而那一层已整层删除（settings.ts 里换成了 groundDetail），源文案的 70m 两边都不对。更要紧的是它只有一句、恒定描述低档，玩家选了高档仍然读到低档的说明，所以拆成三条按档位取；
(2) prologue_speaker / player_speaker —— 英文名对外统一用 Miles Lu，与 promo/ 宣传物一致，避免商店页和游戏里主角叫两个名字；
(3) 四个核心资源的英文名（lvbi_label / collecting_lvbi / shop_balance / shop_need_lvbi / mood_label / shop_mood_full / fragments / fragment_obtained / shop_need_frags / stations_seen 等）—— **源项目的英文直译在界面上读不通**：
    · 旅币 译成 Lvbi（拼音），英文玩家读不出它是什么，而引导页 glossary_lvbi 教的是 Coins；
    · 心神 —— 源项目里 glossary_mood 译成 Heart、mood_label 译成 Composure，**同一个词两种译法**。
      早先的做法是把 mood_label 改成 Heart 去迁就引导页（`verify_i18n_glossary` 守的是
      「引导页教的词 == HUD 用的 label」），但 Heart 是个会被**消耗**的资源：
      收一块碎片掉一格，叫 Heart 会让人本能地以为要「攒」。
      商店里清心茶的描述（shops.json 的 desc_en）一直写的是 Composure，三处本来就对不齐。
      现在**统一成 Composure**：引导页、HUD、商店三处同名，判据 `verify_i18n_glossary` 仍然成立，
      而且 Composure 自带「镇定 / 撑住」的意思，和掉一格就起雾的机制对得上；
    · 碎片 在同一个面板里同时出现 Fragments（表头）和 Shards（计数）；
    判据是 `verify_i18n_glossary`：**引导页教的词与 HUD 用的 label 必须是同一个名词**。
    旅币按项目要求统一用 Coin（不用拼音）。
(3b) 标题页的画质组默认折叠（`fold_open` / `fold_close`），演示按钮在自行车模型到货前
    显示 `demo_loading` / `demo_loading_hint` 并禁用——见 titleScreen.ts 的 `demoReady`。
    加这一组是因为折叠线本身要有一行可点的标题，而「演示等车」必须写在界面上：
    静默降级成徒步的那个 90 秒，是这个游戏作为「骑行游戏」的第一句话。
(4) 驿 的英文一律 Station —— 源项目译作 Post，
    而 post 在英文里读作邮件或职位，不读作驿站。涉及：
    stations_seen / finish_run_hint / revisit_available / synthesis_choice_hint / synthesis_done_message / shop_locked / voice_speaker / home_speaker / back_keep / prologue_0_3 / prologue_1 / objective_return / hud_home_target / touch_home_button / desktop_home_prompt / objective_overdue
    十八驿温泉旅驿 对外是 The Eighteenth Station inn。

zh.quality_hint_low: 最低的一档：阴影与地面细节全关，行道树收到 95m、灌木 40m，雾也拉近 · 植被范围重新进这一趟生效
zh.quality_hint_medium: 中间的一档：阴影 1024px、地面细节铺到 34m，行道树 150m、灌木 80m · 植被范围重新进这一趟生效
zh.quality_hint_high: 最高的一档：全分辨率、阴影 2048px、地面细节铺到 58m，行道树 220m、灌木 140m · 植被范围重新进这一趟生效
zh.postcard_origin: 十八驿的物件。这条路上散着五件前人的乐事——云、茶、琴、竹、禽。到一处坐下来待一会儿，卡上那一格才落得成真；五格齐了，才是一张完整的卡。背面那句话，由你写。
zh.postcard_look_hint: 点一件碎片，看它落在卡上的哪儿、还差几次
zh.key_camera_desc: 切换视角（向前 / 追车 / 骑手）
zh.key_vehicle_desc: 换载具（徒步 / 自行车 / 摩托车 / 滑板）
zh.help_overlay:
W / ↑　加速前进
S / ↓　减速 · 倒车
A / ←　左转　　D / →　右转
空格 / 回车　靠近驿站时打卡
Esc　暂停 · 继续
M　静音
V　切换视角（向前 / 追车 / 骑手）
E　换载具（徒步 / 自行车 / 摩托车 / 滑板）
1 ~ 4　选道具
zh.mg_success_hint: 这一刻收下了 · 驿站上的圆点亮了一格
zh.perf_note: 卡的话把渲染分辨率调低一档 —— 它只改内部采样，画面元素一个都不动。
zh.adaptive_hint: 帧率低于目标时自动降内部渲染分辨率。只降不升，避免画面呼吸。
zh.unsupported_body: 这个游戏需要 WebGL 2。你现在的浏览器没有可用的 WebGL 2 上下文。
zh.unsupported_fix: 可以试：换用较新的 Chrome / Edge / Firefox；在浏览器设置里打开「使用硬件加速」；或换一台带独显的电脑。
zh.touch_why: 摇杆 / 打卡 / 暂停。手机上会自动打开，桌面上也可以手动开。
zh.objective_return: 五件乐事都齐了。回十八驿去。
zh.home_arrive_3: 五件乐事都在这儿了。这一章到这儿。
zh.chapter1_done_line: 188 号环线，一趟。下一章的门开了。
zh.synthesis_home_hint: 第一章完成了。收下这份礼物，或者再骑一圈。
zh.fatal_note: 这一屏是故意留下的——把上面那行字连同浏览器控制台一起反馈，就能定位到具体哪一步。
zh.cap_reason_no_webgl2: 这台浏览器没有可用的 WebGL2
zh.cap_reason_software: 显卡在用软件渲染（没开硬件加速）——画质已压到最低，能跑但会慢
zh.cap_reason_unknown_gpu: 未识别显卡，按中档起步
zh.cap_reason_no_gpu: 浏览器未提供显卡型号，按中档起步
zh.key_relic_desc: 摸路边的旧物 · 竹丛里按节拍
zh.relic_near: 路边有东西被留在这儿。
zh.relic_bowl_text:
指腹压过碗底那道磨痕。
六百年前有人在这儿摔过它，又一片片捡起来粘好。
……补得比我笨。
zh.relic_ring_text:
铜的，磨得只剩一层皮。
六百年里被推过多少次，我数不清。
最后推它的那个，是我妈。
zh.relic_ledger_text:
最后一页是今年的。
客人的名字都还挂着，房钱那一栏空着。
……她走的那天，账就停在这一页。
zh.relic_shoe_text:
鞋底磨穿了，鞋帮上绣着半个「路」。
另一只大概在回去的路上。
它讲不了什么，只是走累了。
zh.relic_key_text:
铜的，还带着锈。
它说：我最后一次开门，是替你妈把门关上的。
……摸到它的时候，我的手在抖。
zh.objective_collect: 五件乐事散在这条路上。
zh.objective_overdue: 期限过了。回十八驿把话说完。
zh.beat_done: 竹：一段路，五个节拍，一口气骑完。
zh.cap_reason_restored: 沿用你上次选的画质档（本次探测：%s）
zh.demo_loading_hint: 自行车还在路上——到货就能看这一趟

en.quality_hint_low: The lowest tier: shadows and ground detail both off, trees pulled in to 95m and shrubs to 40m, and the fog pulled closer — vegetation range applies on your next ride
en.quality_hint_medium: The middle tier: 1024px shadows, ground detail out to 34m, trees at 150m and shrubs at 80m — vegetation range applies on your next ride
en.quality_hint_high: The highest tier: full resolution, 2048px shadows, ground detail out to 58m, trees at 220m and shrubs at 140m — vegetation range applies on your next ride
en.postcard_origin: A thing of the Eighteenth Station inn. Five joys of people long gone lie scattered along this road — Cloud, Tea, Music, Bamboo, Bird. Sit a while at each and the cell on the card turns real; with all five the card is whole. The line on the back is yours to write.
en.postcard_look_hint: Tap a fragment to see where it falls on the card and how many visits are left
en.key_vehicle_desc: Switch ride (on foot / bicycle / motorcycle / skateboard)
en.desktop_home_prompt: Space · Head back to the Station
en.help_overlay:
W / ↑　speed up
S / ↓　slow down · reverse
A / ←　left　　D / →　right
Space / Enter　check in at a station
Esc　pause · resume
M　mute
V　switch camera (forward / chase / rider)
E　switch ride (on foot / bicycle / motorcycle / skateboard)
1 ~ 4　pick an item
en.mg_success_hint: Taken. One more light on the station.
en.perf_note: If it stutters, drop the render scale a step — it only changes internal sampling, not a single element on screen.
en.adaptive_hint: Lowers the internal render resolution when the frame rate falls below target. It only ever goes down, so the picture never breathes.
en.unsupported_body: The game needs WebGL 2, and this browser has no usable WebGL 2 context.
en.unsupported_fix: Try: a newer Chrome / Edge / Firefox; turn on hardware acceleration in your browser settings; or a machine with a dedicated GPU.
en.touch_why: Joystick / check-in / pause. Turns on automatically on phones; you can also force it on a desktop.
en.objective_return: All five joys are gathered. Head back to the Eighteenth Station.
en.home_arrive_3: The five joys are all here. This chapter ends here.
en.chapter1_done_line: The 188 loop, once through. The next chapter is open.
en.synthesis_home_hint: Chapter one is done. Take the gift, or ride one more lap.
en.fatal_note: This screen is here on purpose — send the line above along with your browser console and we can pin down which step failed.
en.cap_reason_no_webgl2: No usable WebGL2 in this browser
en.cap_reason_software: Software rendering (hardware acceleration is off) - quality is at the floor; it runs, slowly
en.cap_reason_no_gpu: The browser reports no GPU model, starting at medium
en.key_relic_desc: Feel an old thing by the road · tap the beat in the bamboo
en.relic_near: Someone left something by the road.
en.relic_bowl_text:
My thumb finds the worn mark on its base.
Six hundred years ago someone dropped it here, and picked it up piece by piece.
...They glued it back worse than I would have.
en.relic_ring_text:
Bronze, worn down to a skin.
I cannot count how many times it was pushed in six hundred years.
The last one to push it was my mother.
en.relic_ledger_text:
The last page is from this year.
The guests are all still listed. The rent column is blank.
...The account stopped on the day she left.
en.relic_shoe_text:
The sole is worn through. Half a character for "road" is embroidered on the side.
The other one is probably on the way back.
It has nothing to tell me. It is just tired.
en.relic_key_text:
Bronze, still rusted.
It says: the last time I was turned, I was your mother shutting the door behind her.
...My hand was shaking when I felt it.
en.objective_collect: The five joys are scattered along this road.
en.objective_overdue: The deadline has passed. Go back to the Eighteenth Station and finish the conversation.
en.beat_done: Bamboo: one stretch of road, five beats, ridden without stopping.
en.glossary_mood_desc: Each fragment costs one. The lower it drops, the thicker the fog.
en.finish_run_hint: Not every station walked yet — this one is rated on what you did ride.
en.revisit_available: The pips in the top bar are still open — two more visits to every station.
en.synthesis_choice_hint: One loop is a whole run: five joys, five characters, one postcard. For the full rating, two more visits to every station.
en.synthesis_done_message: Every station walked three times over. The gift is forming...
en.back_keep: The Eighteenth Station inn is still here with me. If you are lost, knock.
en.prologue_0_3:
There is one more thing I have told no one.
The family business — the Eighteenth Station inn — my mother left it to me the year she disappeared.
It is not an inheritance. It is a sentence she never finished saying.

When you left, the mountains were still here, Mother.
en.prologue_1:
The lawyer's letter arrived.
The Eighteenth Station has lain idle for six years. Open it within thirty days, or the land is taken by law.

I'll go back and take a look.
en.cap_reason_restored: Keeping your saved quality — this machine reports %s
en.demo_loading_hint: The bicycle is still on its way — the demo starts the moment it lands.
